author.name: Horace Chan
author.headline: Expert in applying AI in verification

text:
I chatted with a priest, he said God created humans and gave humans free will, how is it different from human created AI.

My response is AI has no free will.

Then he asked me to think about this.

author.name: Dan B.
author.headline: Seasoned Electrical/FPGA/ASIC/RTL Engineer with individual & managerial experience

comments.text:
Free will is exactly why humans are bad drivers and lack of free will is exactly why robot drivers can be, will be, and already are better drivers than humans. They do what they are told.
As for AI, I'm less sure. Maybe it's "free will" within some bounds? It has no arms and legs, yet. 😂
